question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    COUNT(*) as total_alien,
    SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count,
    AVG(age) as avg_age
  FROM alien_data
  WHERE state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state
),
ranked_states AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    total_alien,
    friendly_count,
    hostile_count,
    avg_age,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_alien DESC) as rank
  FROM state_totals
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_states WHERE rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count
FROM top10
WHERE friendly_count > hostile_count
  AND avg_age > 200;
